name: Three Sevens shortens Burrow Bolt, lengthens Traps and cheapens Dawn Blade (#1654)
contract: Three Sevens 300572 is SpellFamily 21, Attributes 0x1c0 (passive), DurationIndex 21, with three SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) effects, each BasePoints+DieSides 1: effect 0 op 1 (SPELLMOD_DURATION) 6999+1 = +7000 ms over EffectSpellClassMask word 2 bit 0x40000 (Shadow Trap 680238, Inquisitor's Trap 681445, Death Trap 681450 and Scourge Trap 681455 carry that bit in SpellFamilyFlags word 2); effect 1 op 11 (SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN) -7001+1 = -7000 ms over word 2 bit 0x40000000 (only Burrow Bolt 802269, RecoveryTime 40000); effect 2 op 14 (SPELLMOD_COST) -71+1 = -70 (7 Rage, Rage costs are stored x10) over word 0 bit 0x400 (Dawn Blade 802024, Rage cost 300). None of those records carries SPELL_ATTR3_IGNORE_CASTER_MODIFIERS, so Player::ApplySpellMod (Player.cpp:10219) applies the flat mods. Nothing needed a script: the passive is a native spell modifier and the reporter's grep of C++/SQL cannot see it. The trap duration is applied by the summon script through ApplySpellMod(SPELLMOD_DURATION) (AscensionWitchHunterSummons.cpp:408), so the probe reads the same modifier that script reads. The scenario reads each modified value through the native spell_modifier and spell_power_cost probes and pins the untouched controls (Burrow Bolt duration, Trap cooldown, Dusk Blade cost).

steps.label: Before the talent: Shadow Trap duration is untouched
Before the talent: Burrow Bolt cooldown is untouched
Dawn Blade Rage cost before the talent
Dusk Blade Rage cost before the talent
Three Sevens is applied as a passive
Shadow Trap lasts 7 seconds longer (effect 0, op 1 duration, +7000)
Burrow Bolt duration is not a Trap and stays
Burrow Bolt cooldown is 7 seconds shorter (effect 1, op 11 cooldown, -7000)
Trap cooldowns are not touched by the Burrow Bolt mask
Dawn Blade costs 7 Rage less (effect 2, op 14 cost, -70 in tenths)
Dusk Blade is not in the mask and keeps its cost
